about: What a class's own code does to a placed moby when the level starts, which the level data alone does not show (rc1/moby.gd reads it). Each rule names the function it comes from. Offsets are byte offsets into the moby's pvars. "game_hidden": the game's run (moby_states.json) hides it, but not for the reason the editor shows; the text says why it is drawn anyway. "drawn_by_code": its model is never drawn, its class's code draws something else, the text says what; "effect" is what the editor draws for it ("nanotech", "electric_gate", or "game_height": the model where the game's run puts it), only in the states listed in "effect_states" when there is that list. "hidden_if_pvar": hidden while that pvar word is set, which the run cannot see ("hidden_if_pvar_reason" says why); "camera_volumes": the pvar words of the volumes the camera must be inside ("show") or outside ("hide") for it to be drawn.

572.name: large_amoeboid
572.progress: Far from the camera the run may leave it as it spawned: the game updates a moby only within its update distance of the camera.

501.name: nanotech_crate
501.progress: Once Ratchet breaks it, its nanotech ball stays where it was until he picks it up, which he does only below full health.

0.name: ratchet
0.game_hidden: The hero: the level's arrival scene hides him until it ends (space.c), so the editor shows him.

831.name: water
831.drawn_by_code: Its model is not drawn: its class's code draws a rippling water patch (render_water_grids) at the height the game's run gives, where the editor shows the model's square instead.

838.name: electric_gate
838.drawn_by_code: Its model is not drawn: while shut (state 1) its class's code draws five beams across it (draw_electric_gate_beams), which the editor draws too.

44.name: sentrybot
44.game_hidden: Hidden in the run only far from the camera: the game updates a moby only within its update distance of the camera, and sentrybot_update shows it on every update outside a cutscene (it spawns hidden, and a cutscene hides it), so the editor shows it.

577.name: peckbot
577.game_hidden: Hidden in the run only far from the camera: the game updates a moby only within its update distance of the camera, and peckbot_update shows it on every update outside a cutscene (a cutscene, as the level's arrival, hides it), so the editor shows it.

623.name: extermibot
623.game_hidden: Hidden in the run only far from the camera: the game updates a moby only within its update distance of the camera, and extermibot_update shows it again on its first update after a cutscene (the level's arrival hides it), so the editor shows it.
623.hidden_if_pvar_reason: Hidden until woken (pvar 0x2B4): its code puts it 20 below its place with a draw distance of 0, which the run does not count as hidden; a moby's command or Ratchet entering a volume wakes it (pvars 0x2B8, 0x2BC).

625.name: extermitank
625.game_hidden: Hidden in the run only far from the camera, where the game does not update it; extermitank_update never hides it, so the editor shows it.
